parole.significato: counter (desk); table on which business is transacted
parole.testo: From Old Swedish disker, from Old Norse diskr. Borrowed from a West Germanic source, perhaps Old English disc, from Proto-West Germanic *disk. Senses also connect with English desk (“counter”).

parole.significato: Sunday (now generally considered the seventh day of the week in non-religious contexts in Sweden)
parole.testo: From Old Swedish sunnodagher, from Old Norse sunnudagr, borrowed from a West Germanic language. Ultimately from Proto-West Germanic *sunnōn dag, a calque of Latin diēs Sōlis.
